title: Provisional editing directions
html:
PROVISIONAL EDITING DIRECTIONS

Try both task editors

These controls edit the same shared task list.

A · Inline EditINLINE_EDIT
B · Inspector EditINSPECTOR_EDIT
css: .editing{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#edf2f8;background:#101722;border:1px solid #2c394c;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;min-width:0}.editing h2{margin:3px 0}.editing header>p:last-child{margin:0 0 13px;color:#99a8bb;font-size:12px}.eyebrow{margin:0;color:#91a4bf;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em}.edit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.inline-card,.inspector-card{min-width:0;border-radius:13px;padding:13px}.inline-card{background:#142035;border:1px solid #345783}.inspector-card{background:#201a2d;border:1px solid #5b4979}.head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}.head span{font-size:10px;color:#a7b4c7}.inline-list{display:grid;gap:8px;max-height:320px;overflow:auto}.inline-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.8fr) minmax(80px,1fr) minmax(86px,.8fr);gap:6px;padding:8px;background:#18263c;border:1px solid #314864;border-radius:9px}.inline-row input,.inline-row select,.inspector-card input,.inspector-card select{min-width:0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#101826;color:#edf2f8;border:1px solid #40516a;border-radius:7px;padding:7px;font:inherit}.inline-row button{grid-column:1/-1;background:#244b7c;color:#e8f2ff;border:1px solid #4e75a7;border-radius:7px;padding:6px;cursor:pointer}.select-label,.inspector-card form label{display:grid;gap:4px;color:#aab6c6;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}.inspector-card form button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;background:#7654a4;color:white;cursor:pointer}.saved{min-height:16px;margin-top:7px;color:#bba9d3;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:760px){.edit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.inline-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.inline-row input:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
js: let inspectId=null;const replaceTask=(id,patch)=>{const tasks=(api.getState('tasks')||[]).map(t=>String(t.id)===String(id)?Object.assign({},t,patch):t);api.setState('tasks',tasks);};const makeStatusOptions=value=>['Todo','Doing','Done'].map(v=>'<option '+(String(value).toLowerCase()===v.toLowerCase()?'selected':'')+'>'+v+'</option>').join('');const render=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];if(!inspectId&&tasks[0])inspectId=tasks[0].id;const list=root.querySelector('[data-inline-list]');list.innerHTML='';tasks.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='inline-row';row.innerHTML='<input aria-label="Task title"><input aria-label="Owner"><select aria-label="Status"></select><button type="button">Save row</button>';row.children[0].value=t.title||'';row.children[1].value=t.owner||'';row.children[2].innerHTML=makeStatusOptions(t.status);row.children[3].onclick=()=>{replaceTask(t.id,{title:row.children[0].value.trim()||t.title,owner:row.children[1].value.trim(),status:row.children[2].value});api.log(4,'Inline edit saved for '+t.id);};list.appendChild(row);});const sel=root.querySelector('[data-inspector-select]');sel.innerHTML='';tasks.forEach(t=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.id;o.textContent=t.title;o.selected=String(t.id)===String(inspectId);sel.appendChild(o);});if(tasks.length&&!tasks.some(t=>String(t.id)===String(inspectId)))inspectId=tasks[0].id;sel.value=inspectId==null?'':String(inspectId);sel.onchange=()=>{inspectId=sel.value;fillForm();};fillForm();};const fillForm=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[],t=tasks.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(inspectId)),form=root.querySelector('[data-inspector-form]');if(!t){form.hidden=true;return;}form.hidden=false;form.elements.title.value=t.title||'';form.elements.owner.value=t.owner||'';form.elements.status.value=['Todo','Doing','Done'].find(v=>v.toLowerCase()===String(t.status||'todo').toLowerCase())||'Todo';form.elements.due.value=t.due||'';};root.querySelector('[data-inspector-form]').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const f=e.currentTarget;replaceTask(inspectId,{title:f.elements.title.value.trim(),owner:f.elements.owner.value.trim(),status:f.elements.status.value,due:f.elements.due.value});root.querySelector('[data-saved]').textContent='Saved to shared tasks.';api.log(4,'Inspector edit saved for '+inspectId);});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
